caption: The drawing depicts the bottom left corner of a rectangular textile, likely a carpet or tapestry, with intricate patterns and a decorative fringe. The textile features a border composed of interlocking geometric shapes in black, yellow, orange, and red. Inside the border, the background is predominantly black with a complex, ornate design that includes swirling white and gray elements, floral motifs in pink and green, and small bright red accents. The central area within the border is filled with a blue diamond-patterned section. The upper right portion displays a deep red area with intermittent yellow lines forming an irregular pattern, and pale pink flowers positioned where the red and black regions meet. The bottom and left edges of the textile are finished with brown looping fringe. The entire object is set against a plain beige background.
title: Corner of Needlepoint Cushion
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
